<thought>Using the list of functional groups, I will search for retrosynthetic templates that break a carboxylic ester (the bond between the carbonyl carbon and the oxygen) to form a carboxylic acid and an alcohol/ether. This will give a disconnection into a readily available aliphatic acid (penta‑2,4‑dienoic acid) and the remaining cyclic alcohol fragment.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["carboxylic esters"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["aliphatic carboxylic acid", "ether oxygens"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
